decisions.reason: The Demeter natural yogurt extends the firm's established biodynamic range and draws directly on its in-house dairy expertise, farmer relationships and own R&D, so management can interpret sales results and refine this flagship line rather than withdraw it.

The mild sliced cheese builds closely on the firm's in-house cheesemaking know-how and existing retail channels, so the firm can assimilate early market feedback and adjust recipe or packaging at low cost instead of dropping it after one year.

Sliced butter cheese is a familiar format that sits close to the firm's core cheese competence, which gives it the related knowledge to read and act on early results, so keeping and improving the product is the sensible choice.
